 Coram: 
Date: 16 October 2025.
Heard Mr Anish Khandekar, the learned Counsel for the applicants; and Mr Arfan Sait, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing the respondent/State.
2. The learned Counsel for the applicants tendered a copy of the impugned order, which is taken on record and marked "X" for identification.

Upon perusal of the order dated 16 July 2013, passed in RC No.661 of 2013 by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nashik (the impugned order), it is apparent that the order of issuance of process/impugned order is cryptic and unreasoned in a printed form.

The learned Magistrate has affixed a rubber stamp engraved with the following words:
"ORDER Issue process against accused No.1 to16 PU/s 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 C.J.M. Nasik".
__________________________________________________ 16 October 2025 sg 4.apl683-19.docx

After affixing the aforesaid stamp, the Magistrate filled the blank space with the following words:
"16 PU/s 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act 2006"
which is not the appropriate manner in which judicial discretion should be exercised.
The Magistrate needs to demonstrate such application of mind by giving reasons as to why the process is issued against the accused.
Therefore, the impugned order is liable to be quashed and set aside.

However, at the same time, it must be considered that if the Magistrate did not fulfil his duty, the respondent/original complainant should not be held responsible and should not have to endure any consequences due to the Magistrate's lapse.

As a result, the impugned order dated 16 July 2013 of Bunge India Pvt. Ltd. And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra on 16 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39129090/
2 issuance of process in RC No.661 of 2013, pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Nashik, is quashed and set aside and the learned Magistrate is directed to pass an order afresh on its own merits in accordance with the law, expeditiously, and as far as possible within three months from the date of receipt of the order.
3.
